8cxs: Master of Arts – Business and Management – Offers advanced business knowledge across strategy, finance, marketing, and entrepreneurship. Suitable for recent graduates and professionals seeking managerial roles across sectors.
8j7k:
This MBA programme supports students' professional development as managers through the academic study of business, class discussions, networking opportunities, and work-based learning. Students will have the chance to meet like-minded professionals and learn to reflect on and evaluate their own practice and progress.

The programme challenges students to further develop management expertise relevant to their chosen career paths and to build lifelong learning skills that will be crucial for their ongoing professional development.

It is designed to draw on previous experiences while providing opportunities to put newly acquired knowledge into practice in real-life work scenarios. The course also emphasizes collaboration with others as a means to enhance understanding of both business theory and practice.

Authentic assessments involve activities such as pitching, researching, managing projects, and solving real business challenges. Through these activities, students will develop skills valued by employers and applicable across any industry.
8cyj: Master of Business Administration – Leadership and Management – Focuses on developing strategic leadership capabilities for complex organisational settings. Covers change management, innovation, and ethical leadership across sectors.
